environment.online_reward: 0.95 * externally measured correct-case fraction + 0.05 * bounded grammar admission

mechanism_scope: ADAM/Kaine real coding effects; no sovereign ADAM/Kaine weight training

frozen_escalation.trigger: exactly four expected base train records and every completion.status is truncated; any failed/mixed no-completion bank stops

reasoning_budget.interpretation: truncation or OOM is resource limitation, not coding inability
reasoning_budget.verifier_view: bare answer accepted if no channel tokens; otherwise exactly one leading complete Gemma <|channel>thought ... <channel|> frame required; malformed/multiple/nested/stray rejected

recipient: Gemma 4 Lilith LoRA rank 2 last-query projection

release.requires: independent results and cold-process exact adapter reload

retention.metric: mean token NLL on eight frozen transcript validation records

selection.development: four development_holdout tasks, disjoint from policy-update train tasks
selection.rule: max development passes; ties blend > KLPO > SFT
selection.sealed: after decision is durably frozen, selected and unchanged base each evaluate four independent_eval tasks once with shared per-task RNG namespaces

thinking_render_length_audit.target_kind: harvested final answers; no verified reasoning traces
